m1.typescript: m1 images come first with labels and the question last

e1.typescript: e1 the token cost follows the models resolution tier

e2.typescript: e2 formats dimensions sizes and counts are checked before any call

e3.typescript: e3 more than twenty images lower the side limit to 2000 pixels

e4.typescript: e4 an image whose size matters is rejected instead of resized

e5.typescript: e5 pdfs become document blocks in order and are limited by pages

e6.typescript: e6 bedrock and vertex take only base64 sources and smaller images

e7.typescript: e7 coordinates map back to the original and cost follows the price

wrong-edge-only-resize.defect: sizes an image by the edge limit alone and ignores the visual token budget

wrong-text-first.defect: puts the question before the images

wrong-no-labels.defect: does not label the images when there are several

wrong-padded-coordinates.defect: divides a returned coordinate by the padded height instead of the resized height

wrong-same-limit-all-models.defect: allows 600 images for every model, including the 200k-context one

wrong-many-image-rule.defect: ignores the 2000 pixel limit that applies above 20 images

wrong-exact-silent.defect: lets an oversized image through even when its exact size matters
